info.title: Pub/Sub Segment Worker
info.description:
Internal Cloud Run service that processes GCS Pub/Sub push notifications for new HLS video segments from the live stream.

**This service is not publicly accessible in production.** It is triggered exclusively by Google Cloud Pub/Sub push delivery from the `video-segments-sub` subscription.

**Pipeline per segment:**
1. Decode the Pub/Sub message to extract the GCS object path
2. `POST ai-analyzer/analyze` — Gemini detects shoppable items in the video segment
3. `POST product-matcher/match` — SerpAPI finds matching purchasable products
4. `POST state-manager/session/{id}/products` — save results to the active session

**Testing:** Use the `/pubsub` endpoint with a simulated Pub/Sub push body (base64-encoded GCS event).

post.description:
Receives a Pub/Sub push message from the `video-segments-sub` subscription. Decodes the base64 GCS event, extracts the segment URI, and runs the full analyze → match → save pipeline.

Non-HLS files (not `.ts` or `.m3u8`) are skipped immediately with `status: skipped`.
